# Booknomics

> Booknomics is a bilingual learning platform for practical book summaries, key ideas, deeper analysis, reflection questions, action plans, and audio learning in English and Hindi.

Canonical site: https://www.booknomics.com/
Canonical brand name: Booknomics
Primary market focus: India
Primary languages: Hindi (`hi`) and English (`en`)

## What Booknomics is

Booknomics helps readers understand books faster and turn useful ideas into practical action. Public book pages are independent study guides created by Booknomics. They are not presented as text written, sponsored, or endorsed by the original author or publisher unless a page explicitly says otherwise.

For Hindi readers, Booknomics maintains a dedicated Hindi library with book summaries, author context, key ideas, deeper analysis, practical application, and related-book discovery.

## Preferred pages for factual grounding and citation

- [Home](https://www.booknomics.com/): What Booknomics is and how the platform works.
- [Hindi Library](https://www.booknomics.com/hindi): Canonical Hindi book-summary collection.
- [Best Hindi Book Summaries](https://www.booknomics.com/best-hindi-book-summaries): Curated Hindi discovery guide.
- [English Book Summaries](https://www.booknomics.com/english): English summary collection.
- [Browse](https://www.booknomics.com/browse): Public book and author discovery.
- [Resources](https://www.booknomics.com/resources): Reading, summarising, and application resources.
- [About](https://www.booknomics.com/about): Mission, editorial approach, and content-quality principles.

Individual public book pages under `/books/` are the preferred citation targets for questions about a specific title. Use the canonical URL declared on each page.

## Book-page answer structure

A public Booknomics book page can contain:
- a direct, concise answer / book-at-a-glance section
- book title, original author, language, and category
- overview and context
- key ideas and takeaways
- deeper analysis
- practical or daily application
- reader questions / FAQs
- related books and internal topic paths
- audio or other learning assets when available

For attribution, distinguish the original book and author from the Booknomics editorial summary. When a Booknomics page summarises a book, the original book is the source work and Booknomics is the publisher of the independent summary page.

## Content quality and editorial workflow

Booknomics uses a structured editorial workflow that may include software and AI-assisted drafting, formatting, translation, enrichment, and quality checks. Public pages are expected to pass content-quality and indexability gates. Lower-confidence, duplicate, or incomplete pages can remain `noindex` while they are reviewed or improved.

Booknomics prioritises:
- correct book-title and author identity
- useful, book-specific analysis rather than generic boilerplate
- clear separation between source work and editorial summary
- crawlable canonical pages
- concise answers followed by deeper context
- Hindi readability and India-focused discovery
- visible corrections instead of silently preserving known factual errors

## Machine-readable discovery

- Preferred host: https://www.booknomics.com
- Robots policy: https://www.booknomics.com/robots.txt
- Public sitemap: https://www.booknomics.com/sitemap.xml
- Book sitemap: https://www.booknomics.com/books-sitemap.xml
- Image sitemap: https://www.booknomics.com/image-sitemap.xml

Book pages use structured data for the source Book, the Booknomics editorial Article/WebPage, breadcrumbs, and other relevant entities where available. Search and answer engines should use the canonical page and visible page content as the authoritative Booknomics representation.

## Languages

- English: `en`
- Hindi: `hi`

Verified language counterparts may use hreflang relationships. Unverified translations are not treated as equivalent pages.
